series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: Through 2015, 90% of enterprises will bypass broad-scale deployment of Windows 8.
entries.subject: Windows 8 enterprise deployment
entries.metric: share of enterprises bypassing broad Windows 8 deployment

entries.quote: By Year-End 2014, three of the top five mobile handset vendors will be Chinese.
entries.subject: Chinese mobile handset vendors
entries.metric: number of top five handset vendors that are Chinese

entries.quote: By 2015, big data demand will reach 4.4 million jobs globally, but only one-third of those jobs will be filled.
entries.subject: Big data jobs
entries.note: Also: only one-third of those jobs filled.

entries.quote: By 2014, European Union directives will drive legislation to protect jobs, reducing offshoring by 20 percent through 2016.
entries.subject: EU job protection and offshoring

entries.quote: By 2014, IT hiring in major Western markets will come predominantly from Asian-headquartered companies enjoying double-digit growth.
entries.subject: Asian companies in Western IT hiring

entries.quote: By 2017, 40 percent of enterprise contact information will have leaked into Facebook via employees' increased use of mobile device collaboration applications.
entries.subject: Enterprise contact data leaking to Facebook
entries.metric: share of enterprise contact information leaked into Facebook

entries.quote: Through 2014, employee-owned devices will be compromised by malware at more than double the rate of corporate-owned devices.
entries.subject: BYOD malware
entries.metric: malware compromise rate of employee-owned vs corporate devices

entries.quote: Through 2014, software spending resulting from the proliferation of smart operational technology will increase by 25 percent.
entries.subject: Smart operational technology software spending

entries.quote: By 2015, 40 percent of Global 1000 organizations will use gamification as the primary mechanism to transform business operations.
entries.subject: Gamification
entries.metric: share of Global 1000 organizations using gamification as primary transformation mechanism

entries.quote: By 2016, wearable smart electronics in shoes, tattoos and accessories will emerge as a $10 billion industry.
entries.subject: Wearable smart electronics

entries.quote: By 2014, market consolidation will displace up to 20 percent of the top 100 IT services providers.
entries.subject: IT services market consolidation
entries.metric: share of top 100 IT services providers displaced

notes: Edition covers '2013 and beyond'. Gartner's stated count: not stated (press release states no count). Found in public source: 11 top predictions. gartner.com returns 403 to scripted fetches; text read from the Internet Archive snapshot listed in sources. Quotes are the prediction headline sentences as printed in the press release; body text is not stored.
